# Manchester United Land Uruguayan Midfielder Ugarte in Ambitious Summer Move

Manchester United have secured the services of Manuel Ugarte in a deal worth up to €60m from Paris Saint-Germain, marking another significant statement of intent from the Old Trafford club as they seek to reclaim their position among Europe's elite.

The Uruguayan international, just 23 years old, put pen to paper on a five-year deal with an option to extend for an additional year, becoming Erik ten Hag's fifth major signing of what has been a transformative summer transfer window.

Ugarte arrives at Manchester United with a reputation as one of the most tenacious midfielders in European football. His arrival provides ten Hag with genuine competition and depth in the defensive midfield position, where the aging Casemiro has struggled to maintain his previous standards. The Brazilian's decline last season was evident, and the addition of Ugarte offers the Dutch manager tactical flexibility and fresh legs in a crucial area of the pitch.

The young Uruguayan wasted no time in endearing himself to supporters, speaking passionately about his desire to bring success back to the club. His words about sacrifice and determination resonated with a fanbase hungry for a return to the glory days.

Sporting director Dan Ashworth, who joined the club earlier in the summer, revealed that Ugarte had been a priority target throughout the window. The recruitment team had identified the midfielder as the perfect profile to complement the existing squad and provide the steel needed in central areas.

United fans will be eager to see their new signing in action at Old Trafford, where the atmosphere promises to inspire the combative midfielder to give everything for his new club.

Any other questions?
